blocks.x: Data & Lakehouse for Medical Devices & MedTech — trusted data at decision speed — pipelines, lakehouse and governance that stand up to audit applied to the medical devices & medtech operating unit of Healthcare & Life Sciences.

MedTech sells outcomes and must prove them: connected devices generate telemetry that feeds service revenue, clinical evidence and regulatory post-market surveillance. The device-to-evidence loop is an engineering product — and EU MDR/CRA raise its bar.

items: MDR vigilance and performance data assembled manually; signal detection late.
Installed base lacks provisioning/OTA; service runs on reactive dispatch and field guesswork.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Enterprise BI & Executive Analytics, Lakehouse Architecture & Migration, Advanced Risk & Predictive Analytics from the Data, Analytics & Lakehouse tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Device provisioning/OTA, Service dispatch, Vigilance reporting) on Fleet Management System and EEMS Platform. Governance inherits the sector frame — EU MDR among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Resilient, observable pipelines — trusted data from source to decision at SLA.
Lakehouse the right way — Unity Catalog governance, cost-aware design and AI-ready foundations.
Decisions at event speed — sub-second pipelines from sensor, click or transaction to action.
device telemetry + complaints into signal detection (surveillance proactive)
